title: What is *temperature*?
analogy: A creativity dial: low plays it safe, high takes chances.

steps.name: You ask
steps.desc: "Suggest a name for our new cafe."

steps.name: It turns the dial
steps.desc: Low: picks the safest next word. High: bolder picks.

steps.name: It answers
steps.desc: Low: same answer each time. High: fresh ideas, more slips.
